archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-docs
archetypes.rationale: Bgjob source docs and compatibility wording changed across shared prompts and public docs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed bgjob wait documentation for source-of-truth drift. Check that generic bgjob gates, Step 8 handoff routing, merge-env truncation, and per-lane slug guidance stay consistent across shared prompts and public docs. Pay special attention to compatibility-only task-notification wording that should not re-authorize migrated waits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
